position: Delete the tokens column and the derived tps column from the UI. Do not install tokens-hook.sh — not as written, not 'fixed.' R1 measured a 92% undercount on real agentic traffic; R2 shows hooks carry no usage and the transcript is an officially unstable internal format; R5 shows request_log.tokens is display-only and drives zero routing. The plumbing is a museum piece, not a mandate. Keep schema/aggregation/hook dormant (zero migration, git-revertible), rewrite the stale F4 comments, and stop pretending a composite that is 95% discounted cache-read answers any question the fleet is asking.

claims.claim: tokens-hook.sh as written captures ~8% of billed tokens on a real multi-turn session (92% undercount), and is exact only for single-message turns
claims.evidence: CHAIR R1b: this session's transcript, deduped by message.id — 65 unique msgs / 5 turns; hook last-only sum 660,530 vs actual 8,300,849 (8.0%); turn 3 (38 msgs, agentic) captured 3.1%

claims.claim: Claude Code Stop/hook payloads carry no token or usage fields; the supported path is first-party OTel (claude_code.token.usage / claude_code.cost.usage / claude_code.llm_request)
claims.evidence: CHAIR R2: greps on installed binary ~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.238 hit claude_code.token.usage, claude_code.cost.usage, CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY, OTEL_*; Operator docs: hooks expose only session_id/transcript_path/cwd/permission_mode/hook_event_name/prompt_id

claims.claim: The session transcript JSONL is officially internal, version-unstable, and async-written — so a fail-open transcript parser's failure mode is silent zeroes, indistinguishable from today's bug
claims.evidence: CHAIR R2 citing Anthropic docs retrieved with the research bundle; tokens-hook.sh header already admits format 'has shifted before' and fails open (brief C2)

claims.claim: request_log.tokens is display-only; no selector/routing/alerting path reads it
claims.evidence: CHAIR R5 full grep of src/server.js: every tokens read feeds /api/logs or /api/stats display (lines 301,306,313/314,847); /api/select never references it

claims.claim: Deleting the UI tokens (and tps) columns is operationally inert and fully reversible
claims.evidence: R5 (no consumers) + R4a (tps = tokens/3600 at src/server.js:847, also dead in prod by_host_1h) + UI confined to public/index.html ~412-435; git revert restores

claims.claim: Installing tokens-hook.sh would be a third INSERT producer and corrupt displayed requests counts against 11,167 rows of prior semantics
claims.evidence: R4b: prompt-hook.sh:25 and aigate-run.sh:23 already POST /api/events/prompt; server.js:823 unconditional INSERT; hook posts another row with prompt:"" (C1)

claims.claim: The summed 'tokens' figure is ~95% cache_read, billed at a deep discount — not cost, not context size, not throughput
claims.evidence: CHAIR R1c: input_tokens ≈2 negligible; cache_read grows monotonically and dominates; output_tokens alone are the clean additive 'work' metric; last-message cache_read+cache_creation ≈ end-of-turn context pressure

claims.claim: Trinity's claim that token usage is 'the core metric for a token-budget account router' is false of this codebase
claims.evidence: R5: account selection uses the poller's usage-limit/reset path, not request_log.tokens; column empty across 11,167 prod rows with no attributed routing failure (F3)

claims.claim: Any future revival should be OTel/prometheus scrape into existing /api/metrics — not a bash transcript parser — and only after U5 names the consumer metric (cost vs output vs context pressure)
claims.evidence: R2 official OTel counters exist; R3 aigate already exports Prometheus at server.js:854; R1c splits three real metrics hiding under one header
claims.test: Enable CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1 with OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=otlp|prometheus on one host, run one agentic turn, confirm claude_code.token.usage attributes (type/model/host) match dashboard grain; if yes and a named consumer exists, design against that — else leave deleted

challenges.their_claim: Do not delete the column; token usage is the core metric for a token-budget account router, and 95% of the plumbing is already built
challenges.problem: R5 falsifies the premise: nothing in /api/select or any server path reads request_log.tokens. Plumbing that no decision consumes is not '95% done core product' — it is display chrome. R1 further shows the remaining 5% is not a wire; the written producer is 92% wrong on the fleet's actual workload.
challenges.test: Already run: R5 grep + R1 transcript measurement. Retract 'core metric' or cite the selector line that reads request_log.tokens.

challenges.their_claim: Redesign and wire via correlated PATCH + split fields; delete only if the multi-message experiment fails
challenges.problem: The experiment Morpheus gated on has been run (R1) and failed harder than the brief feared: 8% capture, not 'maybe undercount.' R2 also kills the hook/transcript approach entirely — official path is OTel, hooks carry no usage. A PATCH endpoint that amends rows from an unstable fail-open parser is polishing the wrong instrument.
challenges.test: Accept R1/R2 as the gate Morpheus named; if still pro-wire, propose an OTel-based design with a named consumer (U5) rather than a fixed transcript hook.

challenges.their_claim: Wire it, redesign it, or delete it — treating redesign-via-tokens-hook as a live peer option
challenges.problem: After R1+R2 the redesign-the-hook branch is not peer to delete. The hook's dependency (transcript) is officially unsupported; its accuracy on agentic turns is measured-bad; its metric is undefined (C4/R1c). Honest options are: delete now, or a different architecture (OTel) gated on U5 — not 'fix the bash parser.'
challenges.test: None remaining on the hook path; U5 consumer interview is the only open product question.
